mapper.select: select g.grade_name AS hak_info, '2026' AS yyyy, '02' AS mm, sc.subject_name AS week_subject, book.book_name AS week_title, book.publisher AS week_publisher, book.book_image_url AS week_bookimg from erp_book_suggest book JOIN erp_grade_code g ON book.class_key = g.book_class_key LEFT JOIN erp_subject_code sc ON book.subject_key = sc.subject_key WHERE g.grade_key = #{gradeKey} AND book.yy = '2026' AND book.mm = '02' order by book.yy, book.mm, book.week

select g.grade_name AS hak_info, sc.subject_name AS week_subject, book.book_name AS week_title, book.publisher AS week_publisher, book.book_image_url AS week_bookimg from erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_book_suggest book ON t.class_key = book.class_key and t.yy = book.yy and t.mm = book.mm LEFT JOIN erp_subject_code sc ON book.subject_key = sc.subject_key WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} order by t.yy, t.mm, book.week
